evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours sanitised runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No reconciled per-trade ledger containing notional, pre-trade quote, realised token deltas, all fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, platform fees and terminal status.
No money-weighted NET P&L, profit factor, drawdown, tail-loss and capital-duration series by strategy, chain, asset, route and market regime.
No failure-stage telemetry separating quote, RPC, simulation, signing, nonce/blockhash, broadcast, landing, confirmation and reconciliation failures, including costs incurred.
No Solana forward executable entry/exit quote record with dynamic priority fees, account-creation costs, refundable rent, sellability and congestion conditions.
No EVM comparison of simulated versus realised output, gas, builder payment, latency shortfall and post-broadcast reconciliation.
No out-of-sample chronology demonstrating that learned-route features were computed solely from information available before each decision.

Before any promotion, provide at least 30 days of forward SHADOW evidence, cost-complete reconciled outcomes, positive money-weighted NET P&L and profit factor after all costs, acceptable drawdown/tail loss, stable sellability, and separately acceptable execution-failure rates. Until then profitability, CANARY readiness and LIVE readiness remain unproven.

proposals.downside_risk: Sparse routes may remain dormant longer and apparent opportunity counts may fall.

evidence.detail: Proven observations are collected, but avg_net_base is calculated only from observations with net_base greater than zero.
Replicability increases with the number of positive observations without an equivalent penalty for proven losses.
The adapter selects only patterns whose positive-only avg_net_base is greater than zero and exposes that value as historical net edge.

proposals.expected_effect: Require all proven route outcomes, including losses, to contribute to notional-weighted net return after gas, builder payments and other execution costs; reduce false SHADOW eligibility.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independently reconciled, time-ordered route outcomes across at least 10 market regimes or days, with both successful and failed attempts retained.
proposals.rationale: This is a STRATEGY/MARKET evidence defect: losing executions of the same route are excluded from the learned mean, creating survivor bias and potentially treating a negative-expectancy route as historically positive.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay each route chronologically using only prior observations. Compare the current positive-only score with an all-outcome, notional-weighted estimator including gas and builder costs. Continue only if the latter produces positive out-of-sample net P&L with profit factor above 1.2; stop the route test on non-positive cumulative net, two consecutive material losses, or missing cost/outcome fields.

proposals.downside_risk: More conservative cost reserves may eliminate most apparent leader-copy entries, especially at small notionals.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events deliberately expose zero current gross edge, liquidity and sellability and cannot provide executable outcomes.
Entry screening measures immediate Jupiter round-trip loss and deterioration versus the leader, but does not prove positive forward expected return.
SHADOW exit economics subtract a fixed configured exit-fee estimate rather than measured dynamic priority fees, account-creation costs and execution failure costs.

proposals.expected_effect: Produce realistic delayed-follower, money-weighted Solana NET P&L distributions and abstain when executable edge does not cover price impact, slippage, priority fees and failure probability.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 forward SHADOW decisions, 50 independently sellable closed outcomes, 30 days, and coverage of congestion and low-liquidity periods.
proposals.rationale: Leader profitability is historical context, not executable follower edge. Market loss from adverse post-entry price movement must be separated from infrastructure failures such as stale quotes, Jupiter/RPC errors, simulation rejection, expired blockhash, failed landing or unreconciled balances.
proposals.shadow_test: For each untouched leader BUY, timestamp a follower decision and obtain executable entry plus immediate sell quotes at the exact intended notional. Track subsequent executable exits and charge quoted price impact, slippage, measured priority/base fees, non-refundable account costs and failed-attempt costs while identifying refundable rent separately. Stop if cumulative net is non-positive, the 95th-percentile execution shortfall breaches the configured reserve, sellability fails, or infrastructure-failure rate exceeds 5%.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative unresolved-state accounting can temporarily understate performance until reconciliation completes.

evidence.detail: Realised net subtracts cycle gas from wrapped-balance change, but the recorded realised_net_base remains before profit share and separate fee-settlement gas.
The broad exception path records REJECTED with an empty transaction hash even when a transaction may already have been broadcast and confirmation merely timed out.
Canary state distinguishes a generic execution_failure from realised P&L, but lacks granular failure stages and their incurred gas/capital costs.

proposals.expected_effect: Enable reliable money-weighted user NET P&L after platform fees and all transaction costs, while making strategy selection robust to execution-failure probability and avoiding duplicate or misclassified attempts.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 opportunities with complete stage timestamps, 50 reconciled broadcasts and 30 days of cost-complete terminal outcomes per EVM chain.
proposals.rationale: A landed negative-net transaction is a STRATEGY/MARKET loss when execution matched the approved route and economics simply deteriorated. Quote, simulation, RPC, nonce, broadcast, confirmation or reconciliation faults are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. Ambiguous post-broadcast states must not become strategy losses or cost-free rejections.
proposals.shadow_test: Join every SHADOW/live observation to a terminal outcome category: NO_BROADCAST, REVERTED, LANDED_UNRECONCILED, LANDED_RECONCILED, or STRATEGY_NET_LOSS. Compute user net after route gas, profit share, fee-settlement gas and failed-attempt costs. Stop evaluation if any broadcast lacks signature persistence, unresolved outcomes exceed 1%, or aggregate net changes sign after full costs.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative thresholds can miss genuine short-lived opportunities.

evidence.detail: Net edge explicitly deducts fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve.
Common eligibility requires positive net edge plus minimum liquidity, sellability and quote freshness.
Quote/simulation outcomes are explicitly marked non-promotional rather than treated as realised P&L.
Missing EVM scanner safety fields fail closed before wallet simulation and signing.

proposals.expected_effect: Continued abstention on stale, illiquid, unsellable or cost-negative opportunities.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 forward rejected and 100 eligible observations per chain family across 30 days.
proposals.rationale: These controls correctly prefer no trade over unsupported edge and preserve chain-specific cost inputs. They should remain mandatory while the evidence and accounting improvements are tested.
proposals.shadow_test: Retain all gates and record every rejection alongside a hypothetical cost-complete outcome. Reconsider thresholds only if at least 100 rejected observations show positive out-of-sample NET P&L after all chain-specific costs without higher tail loss or execution-failure rates; stop on any sellability or safety-control regression.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy based on repository architecture, historical win count or positive quote simulations.
rejected_ideas.reason: No fresh runtime forensics or reconciled out-of-sample money-weighted NET P&L is available, and quote simulations are explicitly non-promotional.

rejected_ideas.idea: Relax liquidity, sellability, simulation, wallet, signing, reserve, stop-loss, circuit-breaker, nonce or reconciliation protections to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: Trade count has no value without positive executable edge and weakening these controls would increase tail and execution risk.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all failed or unconfirmed transactions as strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: RPC, quote, simulation, broadcast, confirmation and reconciliation failures are execution/infrastructure evidence and require separate classification, although any incurred gas must still reduce total NET P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use a universal fixed fee or edge threshold across Solana and EVM.
rejected_ideas.reason: Solana priority fees, account rent and Jupiter execution differ materially from EVM gas, builder payments, nonce and atomic route economics.

summary: Architecture-only review completed successfully. Current executable-edge, sellability and simulation gates are appropriately fail-closed, but Learned Route Replication has positive-only selection bias and outcome accounting does not yet establish durable money-weighted user NET P&L. Solana leader copying remains SHADOW and lacks contemporaneous forward edge plus measured priority-fee, price-impact and account-rent economics. Strategy/market losses must be recorded separately from RPC, quote, simulation, broadcast, confirmation and reconciliation failures. With runtime forensics unavailable, no strategy is claimed profitable, canary-ready or live-ready.
